      public static void InsertOptions(int optionsID, int option1Archetype, int option2Archetype, int option3Archetype, String option1, String option2, String option3) throws SQLException
      insert a set of answer options if its ID is not present
      Parameters:
      optionsID - the option set's unique ID
      option1Archetype - the archetype ID associated with the first answer
      option2Archetype - the archetype ID associated with the second answer
      option3Archetype - the archetype ID associated with the third answer
      option1 - the text of the first answer

      option3 - the text of the third answer
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the option set cannot be inserted
